name: BSP_HudPowerupManagerScreen_LoadLayout
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet hud_screen_pages, docs/HUD_SCREEN_PAGES.md. Vtable +14h of HUD screen slot 4Fh (manager +C0h). Loads GUI_support_full, the same page as slot 4Eh, and GUI_powerups_info, and binds 16 widgets including New_Group, power_up_Group, radar_Icon and the circle icons. Whether the two screens share one page instance depends on the name cache 00AA3140.
